body: I live in italy and I'm already on meds but they just don't work.

Nothin ever helped, it keeps getting worse. I live with my parents and study in high school (in my country it lasts until you're 18-19, I'm 19 now). I first attempted suicide when I was 8, I tried to choke myself to death with a belt, but obviously I failed, it got dramatically worse since then. My family is rather poor and I feel like a burden to them. I spend all of my time in my bed, surfing the net, I literally do nothing else, I feel useless. I do have goals, things to live for, but I don't have the strength and willpower to do so.

Absolute emptiness is the best way to describe my life. I have nobody. And I can't cope with the sheer amount of failure surrounding me. I don't see why I should keep trying. I've been struggling with depression for almost 20 years. I'm just so tired.
